title: Learning to Reason from Reference Samples Alone: Reinforced Adversarial Learning for Modern LLM Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.38851v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In many settings where LLM post-training is desirable, high-quality answers are recognizable but difficult to score with explicit rewards. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is limited to tasks where an explicit correctness signal is available. Prior adversarial approaches to training reasoning LLMs either complement verifiable rewards with co-trained critics or require reference reasoning traces. We ask whether a co-trained LLM judge can turn reference answers alone into the sole reward for on-policy post-training of reasoning LLMs. We call this method Reinforced Adversarial Learning (RAL). We first validate RAL on three verifiable tasks (integer multiplication, code-based arithmetic-expression synthesis, and SMILES-to-formula translation), using the verifiers only for evaluation. translated_title: 仅凭参考样本学习推理：面向现代大语言模型后训练的强化对抗学习
translated_abstract: 在许多需要对大语言模型进行后训练的场景中，高质量答案是可辨识的，但难以用显式奖励来打分。带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）仅限于存在显式正确性信号的任务。以往训练推理型大语言模型的对抗方法，要么需要用共同训练的评论者来补充可验证奖励，要么需要参考推理轨迹。我们探究共同训练的大语言模型评判者能否仅凭参考答案，将其转化为推理型大语言模型在策略后训练中的唯一奖励信号。我们将该方法称为强化对抗学习（RAL）。我们首先在三个可验证任务（整数乘法、基于代码的算术表达式合成以及SMILES到分子式的翻译）上验证RAL，其中验证器仅用于评估。在评判者能力足够强且训练充分的情况下，RAL的表现可媲美直接的RLVR。随后我们将RAL应用于两个场景的科学摘要生成任务（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出强化对抗学习（RAL）方法，通过共同训练的大语言模型评判者，仅凭参考答案即可作为推理型大语言模型在策略后训练的唯一奖励信号，无需显式可验证奖励或参考推理轨迹，且实验表明其性能可媲美直接的RLVR。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Reinforced Adversarial Learning (RAL), which leverages a co-trained LLM judge to turn reference answers alone into the sole reward for on-policy post-training of reasoning LLMs, matching direct RLVR performance without requiring explicit verifiable rewards or reference reasoning traces.
